name: Melanoma and Neural System Tumor Syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Diagnostic Criteria for Melanoma and Neural System Tumor Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of multiple primary cutaneous melanomas confirmed histologically
Occurrence of neural system tumors including schwannomas, neurofibromas, or malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors
Family history of melanoma and/or neural system tumors in first-degree relatives
Identification of pathogenic germline mutations in genes associated with melanoma and neural tumors (e.g., CDKN2A, NF1)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of both multiple primary cutaneous melanomas and neural system tumors, with or without family history or genetic confirmation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is recommended to support diagnosis but is not mandatory.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Peripheral nerve sheath tumors (schwannomas or neurofibromas)

common.symptomName: Localized neurological deficits related to tumor location

occasional.symptomName: Headaches associated with intracranial neural tumors

visual changes from optic pathway lesions

laboratory: Histopathological confirmation of melanoma and neural tumors
Elevated serum lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) in advanced melanoma
imaging: MRI showing neural tumors such as schwannomas or neurofibromas
PET-CT for melanoma staging and metastasis detection
other: Dermatoscopic features of atypical melanocytic lesions
Family pedigree analysis showing autosomal dominant inheritance pattern

distinguishingFeatures: Multiple atypical nevi without neural tumors
Lack of neural system tumor involvement

redFlags: New onset neurological deficits in patients with known melanoma
Family history of melanoma and neural tumors
